name: Prottay Mojumder
tagline: Aspiring AI/ML Researcher | Deep Learning, Computational Intelligence & Applied Machine Learning | Seeking PhD Opportunities
profileSummary: Prottay Mojumder is an aspiring AI/ML researcher and a Software Engineering undergraduate at Daffodil International University, with a growing focus on deep learning, computational intelligence, and applied machine learning. His research interests lie at the intersection of machine learning theory, neural network architectures, and real-world applications — from epidemic forecasting to scientific computing.

He is passionate about building intelligent systems that bridge mathematical foundations with modern deep learning methods. Currently, he is exploring transformer architectures, reinforcement learning, and graph neural networks, and is actively seeking PhD opportunities where he can contribute to cutting-edge AI research. Beyond research, he is committed to teaching, mentoring, and building a strong academic foundation in machine learning.
